reason: A task-board plugin for coordinating human-created work with agent execution and human acceptance, including scheduling, execution records, checklists, reports, and optional Git worktree operations.

summaries.zh: 用于管理任务看板、协调人工与智能体执行流程，并支持验收清单、执行报告、定时运行和可选 Git worktree 隔离。
summaries.en: A task-board plugin for coordinating human and agent work with task tracking, scheduling, acceptance checklists, execution reports, and optional Git worktree isolation.

capabilities: Creates, edits, moves, comments on, deletes, imports, and exports task records
Manually or periodically starts agent execution sessions for tasks
Runs agent sessions in project directories or Git worktrees with available tool permissions
Performs Git worktree, branch, diff, and merge operations
Provides taskboard agent tools for task management, checklists, and execution reports
